title: HelioField: the Sun's coronal magnetic field in 3D
description:
HelioField is a web tool that shows the Sun's coronal magnetic field in 3D for any date since May 2010. It draws potential-field source-surface (PFSS) field lines from NSO/GONG and SDO/HMI magnetograms, the source surface and its neutral line, the heliospheric current sheet wound into a Parker spiral, and the magnetic connection of planets and spacecraft (Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter, STEREO, BepiColombo and the L1 fleet) through ballistic Parker spirals and PFSS field lines down to the photosphere. Open field lines can be extended into the heliosphere. Recent days are computed nightly from GONG maps; any other date is solved in the browser from SDO/HMI Carrington-rotation synoptic maps with a spherical-harmonic PFSS solver validated against sunkit-magex. Each spacecraft footpoint carries the flux-tube expansion factor, the distance to the coronal-hole boundary and a WSA-type speed estimate, with their spread over wind speed and source-surface height; open-field footprints show the model's coronal holes; and a solar-cycle series gives open flux, open area, current-sheet tilt and polar field for every rotation since 2010. For dates computed in the browser, the source-surface height can be varied from 1.5 to 3.5 solar radii, and a Schatten current-sheet model can be coupled beyond a cusp surface out to 21.5 solar radii. The browser solver smooths the magnetogram with a tapered spherical-harmonic expansion (degree 80) to avoid ringing. The model results can be downloaded as NetCDF files with a JSON header, preview images and Python scripts that plot them (PNG and PDF) and recompute the corona; the scripts check package versions and update themselves. A Python test suite validates the browser solver against exact PFSS solutions and against sunkit-magex, including a like-for-like comparison on the same smoothed map. The page offers dark and light themes with an accessibility-checked colour scheme, PNG and PDF snapshots, shareable links and an embeddable mode.

Live site: https://sr-dash.github.io/heliofield/
